Upcoming Departures

Please contact us for information about coordinating a departure date!  We can plan any of our pre-determined itineraries, customize a private trip, or organize an independant visit to Nuevo Eden.  

To plan your trip and get a price quote, please reach out to us and we’ll be happy to coordinate! 

Join a Group!  

November 

4 Days Machu Wasi: November 10 -13 

5 Days Customized: November 15 – 19 (private) 

December

4 Days Machu Wasi: December 22 – 25 (private) 

6 Days Reserved Zone: December 26 – 31

 

To join a trip, or inquire about new dates, please fill out our inquiry form, linked in the button below. Vamos a la selva!

JOIN A TRIP - INQUIRE TODAY!
